# Join

Joins the elements of an array into one string, with a separator between each two.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Join(values, separator)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `values` | array | The array to join. Each element is written in its string form: a string as it is, a number or a boolean as its text, and null as the text null. An element that is an array, an object or a function is a runtime error. Null is read as the empty array. |
| `separator` | string | The text to put between each two elements. Null is read as the empty string. |

## Returns

String. The elements in order with separator between each two; the empty string for an empty array. Never null.

## Example

`Join(["a", 1, true], "-")` returns `"a-1-true"`.
